card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or digit separators partway through a multi-digit number in a dose, such as the 0 in 500 or the 9 in 29, just before a unit like mg or mL.

modes.label: Later digit in a number
modes.description: A digit after the first digit of a dose or count, where the number is still unfinished.

modes.label: Comma in large numbers
modes.description: The thousands comma inside a number such as 20,000.
modes.example: Greater than or equal to 20<<,>>000 Greater than 30

card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of dose numbers, before the unit like mg or mL appears.
